original_text: Be not afraid of anything. You will do marvellous work. The moment you fear, you are nobody.
source: The Complete Works of Swami Vivekananda, Vol. 3, “Address of Welcome Presented at Calcutta and Reply”

original_text: My Master used to say, he who thinks himself weak will become weak, and that is true.
source: The Complete Works of Swami Vivekananda, Vol. 3, “Address of Welcome Presented at Calcutta and Reply”

original_text: Concentration of the mind is the source of all knowledge.
source: The Complete Works of Swami Vivekananda, Vol. 8, “Six Lessons on Raja-Yoga”

original_text: Education is the manifestation of the perfection already in man.
source: The Complete Works of Swami Vivekananda, Vol. 4, “What We Believe In”

original_text: Keep your thoughts on virtue; what we think we tend to become.
source: The Complete Works of Swami Vivekananda, Vol. 8, “Six Lessons on Raja-Yoga”

original_text: They alone live who live for others, the rest are more dead than alive.
source: The Complete Works of Swami Vivekananda, Vol. 4, “Our Duty to the Masses”

original_text: Persevere through thick and thin, through health and sickness, never miss a day in practice.
source: The Complete Works of Swami Vivekananda, Vol. 8, “Six Lessons on Raja-Yoga”
